name: 01 | The Letter in the Ashes
description:
You find a letter sealed with a broken sun. "If anyone still walks the Ash Road, bring a light. We are not all dead." It is signed Rowan, keeper of a village that no map remembers. This journal tells a story through letters; Rowan and the other named characters are narrators, not spawned NPCs.

Keep a crafting table in your inventory, then claim this entry. Pin your next quest. Claiming each story reward unlocks the next entry. Explore at your own pace; side stories never block the main ending.
